mapper.sql: WITH W_MAIN AS ( SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT , A.AI_INSPE_ENO , A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO , A.QLAS_CRPE_ENO , A.QLAS_SNPE_ENO , A.QLAS_PRG_YN , CASE WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS EXPT , CASE WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' AND C.INPT_MST_SRNO IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS EXPT_SUGI , CASE WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' AND B.DTCT_CNT IS NOT NULL THEN B.DTCT_CNT ELSE 0 END AS EXPT_SF , CASE WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IMPT , CASE WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' AND C.INPT_MST_SRNO IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IMPT_SUGI , CASE WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' AND B.DTCT_CNT IS NOT NULL THEN B.DTCT_CNT ELSE 0 END AS IMPT_SF , CASE WHEN A.QLAS_PRG_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END QA FROM CSPD001TM A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO , COUNT(*) AS DTCT_CNT FROM CSPD007TL WHERE FILT_DTCT_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY INPT_MST_SRNO ) B ON B.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '80' GROUP BY INPT_MST_SRNO HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) C ON C.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO WHERE A.INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1},'-','') )

FROM ( SELECT A.RNK , CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS RNK2 , MAX(A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD) AS AI_INPT_AUT_CD , A.AI_INPT_USER_ID AS AI_INPT_USER_ENO , MAX(A.AI_INPT_USER_NM) AS AI_INPT_USER_NM , SUM(A.EXPT) AS CNT1 , SUM(A.EXPT_SUGI) AS CNT2 , SUM(A.EXPT_SF) AS CNT3 , SUM(A.IMPT) AS CNT4 , SUM(A.IMPT_SUGI) AS CNT5 , SUM(A.IMPT_SF) AS CNT6 , SUM(A.QA) AS CNT7 , SUM(A.EMP_GR_SUM) AS USER_SUM , SUM(A.DAY_AVG) AS DATE_AVG FROM ( SELECT 1 AS RNK , B.AI_INPT_AUT_CD , B.AI_INPT_USER_ID , B.AI_INPT_USER_NM , A.EXPT , A.EXPT_SUGI , A.EXPT_SF , A.IMPT , A.IMPT_SUGI , A.IMPT_SF , A.QA , A.EXPT + A.EXPT_SUGI + A.EXPT_SF + A.IMPT + A.IMPT_SUGI + A.IMPT_SF + A.QA AS EMP_GR_SUM , (A.EXPT + A.EXPT_SUGI + A.EXPT_SF + A.IMPT + A.IMPT_SUGI + A.IMPT_SF + A.QA) / ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT R.INPT_RCP_DT) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT R.INPT_RCP_DT) END FROM W_MAIN R WHERE R.AI_INSPE_ENO = B.AI_INPT_USER_ID OR R.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO = B.AI_INPT_USER_ID OR R.QLAS_CRPE_ENO = B.AI_INPT_USER_ID OR R.QLAS_SNPE_ENO = B.AI_INPT_USER_ID ) AS DAY_AVG FROM W_MAIN A JOIN CSPD101TI B ON B.AI_INPT_USER_ID IN (A.AI_INSPE_ENO, A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO, A.QLAS_CRPE_ENO, A.QLAS_SNPE_ENO) WHERE B.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS RNK , B.AI_INPT_AUT_CD , B.AI_INPT_USER_ID , B.AI_INPT_USER_NM , A.EXPT , A.EXPT_SUGI , A.EXPT_SF , A.IMPT , A.IMPT_SUGI , A.IMPT_SF , A.QA , A.EXPT + A.EXPT_SUGI + A.EXPT_SF + A.IMPT + A.IMPT_SUGI + A.IMPT_SF + A.QA AS EMP_GR_SUM , (A.EXPT + A.EXPT_SUGI + A.EXPT_SF + A.IMPT + A.IMPT_SUGI + A.IMPT_SF + A.QA) / ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT R.INPT_RCP_DT) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT R.INPT_RCP_DT) END FROM W_MAIN R WHERE R.AI_INSPE_ENO = B.AI_INPT_USER_ID OR R.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO = B.AI_INPT_USER_ID OR R.QLAS_CRPE_ENO = B.AI_INPT_USER_ID OR R.QLAS_SNPE_ENO = B.AI_INPT_USER_ID ) AS DAY_AVG FROM W_MAIN A JOIN CSPD101TI B ON B.AI_INPT_USER_ID IN (A.AI_INSPE_ENO, A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO, A.QLAS_CRPE_ENO, A.QLAS_SNPE_ENO) WHERE B.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '03'
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS RNK , B.AI_INPT_AUT_CD , B.AI_INPT_USER_ID , B.AI_INPT_USER_NM , A.EXPT , A.EXPT_SUGI , A.EXPT_SF , A.IMPT , A.IMPT_SUGI , A.IMPT_SF , A.QA , A.EXPT + A.EXPT_SUGI + A.EXPT_SF + A.IMPT + A.IMPT_SUGI + A.IMPT_SF + A.QA AS EMP_GR_SUM , (A.EXPT + A.EXPT_SUGI + A.EXPT_SF + A.IMPT + A.IMPT_SUGI + A.IMPT_SF + A.QA) / ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT R.INPT_RCP_DT) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT R.INPT_RCP_DT) END FROM W_MAIN R WHERE R.AI_INSPE_ENO = B.AI_INPT_USER_ID OR R.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO = B.AI_INPT_USER_ID OR R.QLAS_CRPE_ENO = B.AI_INPT_USER_ID OR R.QLAS_SNPE_ENO = B.AI_INPT_USER_ID ) AS DAY_AVG FROM W_MAIN A JOIN CSPD101TI B ON B.AI_INPT_USER_ID IN (A.AI_INSPE_ENO, A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO, A.QLAS_CRPE_ENO, A.QLAS_SNPE_ENO) WHERE B.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '02' ) A GROUP BY A.RNK, ROLLUP(A.AI_INPT_USER_ID) ) B JOIN CSPD112TI C ON C.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '120' AND C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = B.AI_INPT_AUT_CD

WITH W_S1 AS( SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO AS INPT_MST_SRNO, COUNT(CASE WHEN B.FILT_DTCT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS SW, A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD AS AI_INPT_AUT_CD, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS AI_INPT_USER_NM, A.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT, A.SUGI AS SUGI, A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, A.QA AS QA, A.AI_INPT_USER_ID AS AI_INPT_USER_ID FROM( SELECT CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '01' THEN 'S1' WHEN A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '02' THEN 'S2' ELSE 'QA' END AS AI_INPT_AUT_CD, A.AI_INPT_USER_ID AS AI_INPT_USER_ID, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS AI_INPT_USER_NM, B.INPT_MST_SRNO AS INPT_MST_SRNO, B.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN C.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '80' THEN 1 END) AS SUGI, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN B.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD IN ('30', '40') THEN 1 END) AS SW, B.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, '0' AS QA FROM CSPD001TM B, CSPD101TI A, CSPD008TH C WHERE B.AI_INSPE_ENO = A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO AND B.INPT_MST_SRNO = C.INPT_MST_SRNO AND A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '01' AND B.INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1},'-','') AND B.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('140', '160') GROUP BY A.AI_INPT_USER_ID, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM, B.INPT_MST_SRNO, B.INPT_RCP_DT, B.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD ) A LEFT JOIN CSPD007TL B ON A.INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO GROUP BY A.INPT_MST_SRNO, A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM, A.INPT_RCP_DT, A.SUGI, A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, A.QA, A.AI_INPT_USER_ID ), W_S2 AS( SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO AS INPT_MST_SRNO, COUNT(CASE WHEN B.FILT_DTCT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS SW, A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD AS AI_INPT_AUT_CD, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS AI_INPT_USER_NM, A.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT, A.SUGI AS SUGI, A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, A.QA AS QA, A.AI_INPT_USER_ID AS AI_INPT_USER_ID FROM( SELECT CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '01' THEN 'S1' WHEN A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '02' THEN 'S2' ELSE 'QA' END AS AI_INPT_AUT_CD, A.AI_INPT_USER_ID AS AI_INPT_USER_ID, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS AI_INPT_USER_NM, B.INPT_MST_SRNO AS INPT_MST_SRNO, B.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT, B.QLAS_ALOC_DT AS QLAS_ALOC_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN C.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '80' THEN 1 END) AS SUGI, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN B.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD IN ('30', '40') THEN 1 END) AS SW, B.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, 'NON_QA' AS QA FROM CSPD001TM B, CSPD101TI A, CSPD008TH C WHERE B.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO = A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO AND B.INPT_MST_SRNO = C.INPT_MST_SRNO AND A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '02' AND B.INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1},'-','') AND B.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('140', '160') GROUP BY A.AI_INPT_USER_ID, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM, B.INPT_MST_SRNO, B.INPT_RCP_DT, B.QLAS_ALOC_DT, B.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD
UNION ALL
SELECT CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '01' THEN 'S1' WHEN A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '02' THEN 'S2' ELSE 'QA' END AS AI_INPT_AUT_CD, A.AI_INPT_USER_ID AS AI_INPT_USER_ID, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS AI_INPT_USER_NM, B.INPT_MST_SRNO AS INPT_MST_SRNO, B.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT, B.QLAS_ALOC_DT AS QLAS_ALOC_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN C.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '80' THEN 1 END) AS SUGI, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN B.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD IN ('30', '40') THEN 1 END) AS SW, B.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, 'QA' AS QA FROM CSPD001TM B, CSPD101TI A, CSPD008TH C WHERE B.QLAS_SNPE_ENO = A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO--B.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO = A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO AND B.INPT_MST_SRNO = C.INPT_MST_SRNO AND A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '02' AND B.QLAS_ALOC_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1},'-','')
AND B.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN ('140', '160') GROUP BY A.AI_INPT_USER_ID, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM, B.INPT_MST_SRNO, B.INPT_RCP_DT, B.QLAS_ALOC_DT, B.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD
) A LEFT JOIN CSPD007TL B ON A.INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO GROUP BY A.INPT_MST_SRNO, A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM, A.INPT_RCP_DT, A.SUGI, A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, A.QA, A.AI_INPT_USER_ID ), W_S3 AS( SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO AS INPT_MST_SRNO, COUNT(CASE WHEN B.FILT_DTCT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS SW, A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD AS AI_INPT_AUT_CD, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS AI_INPT_USER_NM, A.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT, A.SUGI AS SUGI, A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, A.QA AS QA, A.AI_INPT_USER_ID AS AI_INPT_USER_ID FROM( SELECT CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '01' THEN 'S1' WHEN A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '02' THEN 'S2' ELSE 'QA' END AS AI_INPT_AUT_CD, A.AI_INPT_USER_ID AS AI_INPT_USER_ID, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS AI_INPT_USER_NM, B.INPT_MST_SRNO AS INPT_MST_SRNO, B.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN C.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '80' THEN 1 END) AS SUGI, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN B.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD IN ('30', '40') THEN 1 END) AS SW, B.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN B.QLAS_CRPE_ENO = A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO AND AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN ('140', '160') THEN 1 END) AS QA FROM CSPD001TM B, CSPD101TI A, CSPD008TH C WHERE B.QLAS_CRPE_ENO = A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO AND B.INPT_MST_SRNO = C.INPT_MST_SRNO AND A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '03' AND B.QLAS_ALOC_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1},'-','') AND B.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN ('140', '160') GROUP BY A.AI_INPT_USER_ID, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM, B.INPT_MST_SRNO, B.INPT_RCP_DT, B.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD ) A LEFT JOIN CSPD007TL B ON A.INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO GROUP BY A.INPT_MST_SRNO, A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM, A.INPT_RCP_DT, A.SUGI, A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, A.QA, A.AI_INPT_USER_ID ), W_WORK AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS WORKING_DAY FROM CSPD118TM WHERE BAS_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1},'-','') AND HLDY_DSCD = '0' )
SELECT W_S1.AI_INPT_AUT_CD AS AI_INPT_USER_AUT_VAL, W_S1.AI_INPT_USER_ID AS AI_INPT_USER_ENO, W_S1.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS AI_INPT_USER_NM, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT1, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SUGI = '1' AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT2, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SW > 0 AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN W_S1.SW ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT3, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT4, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SUGI = '1' AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT5, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SW > 0 AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN W_S1.SW ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT6, 0 AS CNT7, (NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + --NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SUGI = '1' AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SW > 0 AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN W_S1.SW ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + --NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SUGI = '1' AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SW > 0 AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN W_S1.SW ELSE 0 END),0)) AS USER_SUM, TO_CHAR( (NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + --NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SUGI = '1' AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SW > 0 AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN W_S1.SW ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + --NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SUGI = '1' AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SW > 0 AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN W_S1.SW ELSE 0 END),0)) / W_WORK.WORKING_DAY ,'fm999,999,999,999,999,990.00') AS DATE_AVG FROM W_S1, W_WORK GROUP BY W_S1.AI_INPT_USER_ID, W_S1.AI_INPT_AUT_CD, W_S1.AI_INPT_USER_NM, W_WORK.WORKING_DAY
UNION ALL
SELECT '합계' AS AI_INPT_USER_AUT_VAL, NULL AS AI_INPT_USER_ENO, NULL AS AI_INPT_USER_NM, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT1, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SUGI = '1' AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT2, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SW > 0 AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN W_S1.SW ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT3, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT4, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SUGI = '1' AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT5, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SW > 0 AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN W_S1.SW ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT6, 0 AS CNT7, (NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + --NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SUGI = '1' AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SW > 0 AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN W_S1.SW ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + --NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SUGI = '1' AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SW > 0 AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN W_S1.SW ELSE 0 END),0)) AS USER_SUM, TO_CHAR( (NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + --NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SUGI = '1' AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SW > 0 AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN W_S1.SW ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + --NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SUGI = '1' AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S1.SW > 0 AND W_S1.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN W_S1.SW ELSE 0 END),0)) / W_WORK.WORKING_DAY ,'fm999,999,999,999,999,990.00') AS DATE_AVG
FROM W_S1, W_WORK GROUP BY W_WORK.WORKING_DAY HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT W_S2.AI_INPT_AUT_CD AS AI_INPT_USER_AUT_VAL, W_S2.AI_INPT_USER_ID AS AI_INPT_USER_ENO, W_S2.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS AI_INPT_USER_NM, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT1, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.SUGI = '1' AND W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT2, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.SW > 0 AND W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN W_S2.SW ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT3, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT4, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.SUGI = '1' AND W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT5, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.SW > 0 AND W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN W_S2.SW ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT6, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.QA = 'QA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS CNT7, (NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + --NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.SUGI = '1' AND W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.SW > 0 AND W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN W_S2.SW ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + --NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.SUGI = '1' AND W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.SW > 0 AND W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN W_S2.SW ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.QA = 'QA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)) AS USER_SUM, TO_CHAR( (NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + --NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.SUGI = '1' AND W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.SW > 0 AND W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN W_S2.SW ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + --NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.SUGI = '1' AND W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.SW > 0 AND W_S2.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN W_S2.SW ELSE 0 END),0) + NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN W_S2.QA = 'QA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) ) / W_WORK.WORKING_DAY ,'fm999,999,999,999,999,990.00') AS DATE_AVG FROM W_S2,W_WORK GROUP BY W_S2.AI_INPT_USER_ID, W_S2.AI_INPT_AUT_CD, W_S2.AI_INPT_USER_NM, W_WORK.WORKING_DAY
UNION ALL
